# Common end-user issues

Safe steps first. Stop and escalate when a step needs admin rights or could lose data.

| Symptom | Check first | Then | Escalate when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| No internet | Other devices on the same network; Wi-Fi on; airplane mode off | Forget and rejoin the network; restart the router only if it is the person's home network | Many people affected, or office network |
| Slow computer | Restart; free disk space (aim for at least 10 percent free); pending updates | Close heavy apps; check startup apps | Constant high usage with unknown processes (possible security issue) |
| Cannot sign in | Caps lock and keyboard layout; correct account; device date and time | Self-service password reset through the company's normal flow | Account locked, unexpected MFA prompts (security), or no self-service |
| MFA not working | Phone time set automatically; correct authenticator account | Use a backup method the person already set up | Lost phone: IT resets MFA only after identity is verified |
| Printer not working | Printer on, paper, correct printer chosen | Remove and re-add the printer from the approved list | Driver install needs admin rights |
| Video call audio or camera | Correct input and output devices selected in the app; app has permission | Restart the app; test in another app | Hardware fault |
| Disk full | Large downloads and old files | Empty trash; move files to company storage | Company storage limits or system files growing |
| App crashes | Update the app | Clear the app cache from inside the app if offered | Data loss risk or reinstall needed |

## Operating system notes

- Windows: Settings, Windows Update; Task Manager for resource use; Storage settings for disk space.
- macOS: System Settings, General, Software Update; Activity Monitor; Storage in General settings.
- Linux: the distribution's update tool; a system monitor; disk usage tool.
- iOS and Android: Settings, software update; restart; check storage.

Never ask for passwords or codes, and never suggest disabling security software.
